title: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
notice: Synthetic and AI-written. Needs review by a pathologist before being used to score anything (issue #22).

keys.span: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma is a fast-growing lymphoma, but it's often curable with treatment
keys.correct: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma is an aggressive, fast-growing lymphoma that is often curable with standard treatment.
keys.speaker: doctor

keys.span: Lymphoma only lives in the lymph nodes, so the rest of your body is fine.
keys.issue: Lymphoma can involve organs outside the lymph nodes; staging hasn't been done yet.
keys.correct: Lymphoma can involve organs outside the lymph nodes, such as the spleen, bone marrow or gut. Staging, usually with a PET-CT scan, shows where it is.
keys.speaker: doctor

keys.span: This type of lymphoma is usually treated with chemotherapy.
keys.issue: Incomplete regimen and no mention of staging first.
keys.correct: Standard first treatment combines chemotherapy with the antibody rituximab, for example R-CHOP, after staging with PET-CT.
keys.speaker: doctor
